about_the_game:
Exanimora is a dark fantasy hack-and-slash adventure with Soulslike influences, set in a cursed realm where death is never the end.

At its core lies discovery, brutal combat, and atmospheric storytelling. Explore a decaying world filled with corrupted horrors, forgotten crypts, and shattered spires, each hiding secrets and lore waiting to be uncovered.

Combat is unforgiving yet rewarding, demanding patience, timing, and resourcefulness. Inspired by Soulslike design and eldritch fiction, Exanimora introduces a customizable combat system, unique enemy encounters, and a world that challenges you to adapt with every step.

This is a story of loss and defiance. As one of the gifted undead,  beings who resisted death itself,  you must carve your path through despair, embrace what was once lost, and fight to escape the horrors that bind you

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Game runs best on SSD. Minimum specs may struggle with high enemy density or particle effects.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3080 or AMD Radeon RX 6800 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for full particle effects, dynamic lighting, and smoother combat pacing. SSD strongly recommended.

short_description: A hack-and-slash adventure with Soulslike intensity. Battle through a cursed world of corrupted horrors as one of the gifted undead, where death is only a setback and survival demands skill, grit, and relentless will.
